Hi Emma — quick technical note following up on Olga's asks.

- Data residency nuance: our Hosted API can be configured to keep inference logs and embeddings in EU regions only. For strict single-country requirements (e.g., France-only), the Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) is the recommended path because we cannot currently guarantee single-country tenancy on shared Hosted instances.

- KMS/HSM: Private supports customer-managed keys via KMS integration and, for on-prem, HSM via standard PKCS#11 or vendor-specific connectors. That means SwanTech can retain key control and hold key material in your account/ HSM.

- Cross-region fallback: for DR, Redwood supports automated routing rules. If EU capacity is saturated or we detect regional outage, we can optionally failover to compatible EU-APAC model variants, but that behavior must be explicitly enabled in the routing policy and documented in the SLA amendment. For SwanTech's EU-first requirement we can keep fallback disabled by default and allow a manual failover process.

- Audit artifacts: we can provide SOC2 report extracts (summary), access and API call logs, and per-request tracing (redacted) as part of the Private contract. For Hosted and Dedicated we provide aggregated logs and token-level cost/latency traces; Private provides the most granular audit surface.

I'll attach a short bulleted note for Olga to include in your procurement packet.

Cheers,
Vivek
Infrastructure Solutions, Redwood Inference

Olga / Emma —

High-level delta estimates (order-of-magnitude ranges):
- Hosted API (EU region, per-token): lowest unit cost; minimal setup; no dedicated isolation. Good for proofs-of-concept and low-risk traffic.
- Dedicated (EU reserved capacity): ~2-3x Hosted per-month for consistent throughput and isolation guarantees. Includes SLA and reserved GPU pools.
- Private (VPC or on-prem): ~3-6x Dedicated depending on HSM costs, networking, and on-prem hardware amortization. Private also incurs professional services for setup and certifying audit artifacts.

Recommended procurement path: 1) Start with Dedicated pilot scoped for France region if country-level is required; 2) Run a 30-day validation of residency and key management; 3) If full country-level tenancy is mandated, migrate to Private package with key-holding in your KMS/HSM.

Next steps I need from SwanTech to produce a formal SOW and pricing:
- Confirm residency level: France-only or EU-only (by EOD Tue 11/09)
- Provide expected traffic profile (rps, peak concurrency) for pilot
- Confirm whether SwanTech will manage keys (KMS/HSM) or require Redwood-managed envelope keys

I'll also attach a sample canary rollout plan and a quick checklist for procurement (links above). If you prefer, we can include a targeted discount/credit during pilot in the SOW — I can pull that into the draft once we have residency confirmed.
